reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
I just opened this app and in about 3 seconds realized it’s obviously intended to scam you. EVERY “activity”  you can do for points is just an excuse to pump a 1-3 minute (unskipable) ad in your face. Amongst the longest ads of any app ive tried (they even repeat the same 10 second ad for 3 minutes on loop). 

What do you get for these points from movie length ad watching?  A point that gets you an entry into a drawing- no guarantee to win. You’ll watch hundreds of videos (dozens of hours of time) and have NO guarantee of seeing anything from it (yet they get money from EVERY ad you watch).  Sure the occasional person will win, but I wouldn’t put it past them to force a 5 star review for payout (everything else is scammy, so I’d imagine “winning” is no different)

You are a million times better off at other apps that at least gives points with cash value, then you’re guaranteed something, not this scammy “sorry you spent 20 hours watching ads and didn’t win $10 but we made $50 off your frustrating ad experiences- thanks chump “
